account: Today seems mostly ordinary, although the baker's movements and bread deliveries have generated repeated market gossip. Several townsfolk reported the baker carrying wheat at the bakery, then a sack of bread at the inn; later reports placed a sack of bread at plaza_north_1. I have not personally verified those deliveries or their purpose. They could simply be supplying customers. Just now I saw freight give an emerald to the baker near the market, which looks like a purchase, though I did not see what was exchanged in return. I have no evidence of wrongdoing or a shortage. The secretary told me this morning there was no correspondence or town news, and has been carrying books and moving around the plaza. The appointments chest was empty when I checked this afternoon; earlier I saw the secretary take the appointment book, so that is not itself suspicious. My accounts inspection found two stacks of 64 emeralds in the treasury, but I have no earlier balance or ledger to compare them with. I completed my morning market walk and returned home for lunch. My next appointment is tea at three with the neighbour, who personally confirmed the east-bank cottage at (16, -60, 105). It is now 14:14, and the secretary is close enough for a brief update before I leave. I should then return to the office for 16:30 and go home at 19:00.
